name: Adventure Pack Rules
description: What makes the Adventure Pack's guns play: magazines and reloads (the light key reloads), ammo reserves, ammo boxes and spare guns to pick up, headshots that kill, the hitscan Revolver and Sniper Rifle, and the Taser that knocks players over.
authors: Design: Bushido's Adventure Pack (Bushido, re-released by Conan)
